scripts.start: yarn tailwind:build && concurrently -k -n tw,cra -c magenta,cyan "yarn tailwind:watch" "cross-env-shell REACT_APP_VERSION=$npm_package_version craco start"
scripts.start:mocks: yarn tailwind:build && concurrently -k -n tw,cra -c magenta,cyan "yarn tailwind:watch" "cross-env-shell REACT_APP_RUN_MOCKS='run_msw' craco start"
scripts.serve:azure: npm install express compression && node server.js
scripts.build: yarn tailwind:build && cross-env-shell REACT_APP_VERSION=$npm_package_version craco build
